17b691cde048ae5bcb6eb016db0cf0b0: Akoko kukuru (kekere): Mu awọn iṣe ti o dara ṣiṣẹ - Lo awọn eso ti o mọ, awọn eso nigbagbogbo, Ṣojuto awọn irugbin nisẹ, ati ṣetọju irọyin ile.
eecb444e03c5cfd63765206ed78f6676: Lokaci mai ɗan gajeren lokaci (ƙanana): Yi amfani da kyawawan halaye - amfani da tsabta cuttings, ciyawa a kai a kai, da kuma kula da amfanin gona mako, da kuma kiyaye ƙasa takin.
65c2fd51608c25f4a6043340eea51fb8: Lokaci na dogon lokaci (Babban Farm): aiwatar da tsayayyen sarrafa kwaro, kula da tsayayyen tsinkaye, ma'aikata a farkon ganowa.
